title: On the Spectra of Digraph Laplacians
summary: We present several Laplacian-type matrices associated with a loopless digraph $D$: the out-/in-degree Laplacians $\mathcal L_{\mathrm{out}},\mathcal L_{\mathrm{in}}$, the incidence Laplacian $\mathcal L_{\mathrm{inc}}=BB^{\mathsf T}$, and the symmetrized and skew-symmetrized variants $\mathcal S_{\mathrm{out}},\mathcal K_{\mathrm{out}}$.
